branch_independence: Uses only generic grain, join, formula, unit, time, uncertainty, target and receipt contracts.

each netting-set valuation contributes exactly once
temporal versions are non-overlapping or resolved by precedence

metric.aggregation: sum only after per-netting-set formula evaluation; scenario aggregation forbidden without scenario policy
metric.currency: value every input through explicit rate source, direction and valuation instant before addition
metric.missingness: missing collateral valuation is unknown, never zero; zero EAD is a present floored result
metric.population: active in-scope netting sets at valid and recording cut
metric.target: counterparty limit is a separate target edition, never the observed exposure

uncertainty.method: declared scenario distribution or covariance-aware propagation

branch_independence: Uses the same generic grain, join, formula, unit, time, uncertainty, target and receipt contracts as the financial example.
join_proof: occupancy is interval-matched to one eligible bed at the census cut
multiple encounter overlaps for one bed are refused
counts aggregate to facility-service before ratio

metric.aggregation: ratio of separately reaggregated numerator and denominator counts, never average of facility percentages
metric.missingness: unreported staffed status is unknown; zero staffed beds makes ratio undefined rather than zero
metric.population: staffed and operational beds eligible at census instant
metric.target: occupancy target band is a separately governed target, not an observation

time.as_of: valid census instant plus recording cut

metric.unit: dimensionless ratio disclosed as percent; bed counts remain counts
